description: Tunisia's Institut National de la Statistique (INS) published thematic results of the 2024 General Population and Housing Census (RGPH 2024) as Excel workbooks with separate sheets for the nation, 24 governorates, 279 delegations and 2,082 sectors (imadas), each split into urban and rural areas. Housing files give the share of dwellings connected to the STEG electricity network, the SONEDE drinking water network and natural gas, the share by wastewater disposal method (ONAS public sewer, covered pit, open disposal), and household shares by main heating energy and drinking water source; another file counts dwellings in every sector. Nationally 62.9 percent of dwellings discharged wastewater to the ONAS network (82.0 percent urban, 8.0 percent rural); SONEDE water reached 96.3 percent of urban and 61.4 percent of rural dwellings. Format and access: free XLSX downloads without registration from the INS census pages. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): INS Tunisia open licence (commercial and non-commercial reuse permitted). Caveats: values are shares, not counts, some header cells show spreadsheet errors, and results are split across many workbooks. Simulation uses: sector-level connection gaps for water, sewer and gas network extension, and dwelling counts for exposure. Related records: the Morocco RGPH 2014 housing microdata and the Algeria RGPH 2008 urban network tables.

schema_summary: Each thematic workbook has sheets National, Gouvernorats, Délégations and Secteurs; each unit is a block headed by code and name with rows Urbain, Rural and (for some files) Total and one share column per category, e.g. STEG electricity, SONEDE water and natural gas connection, or ONAS public sewer, covered pit, open disposal and other. The dwellings-by-sector file lists district, governorate, delegation and sector codes and names in French and Arabic with dwelling counts
